seo.title: Legal: privacy, cookies, terms and licences | DOM VIRUS
seo.description: The DOM VIRUS legal pages in plain English: privacy, cookies and storage, terms of use, open-source licences and accessibility.

sections.heading: Legal
sections.body: The legal side of DOM VIRUS, in plain English. We collect as little as we can, set analytics cookies only if you say yes, and publish every game as open source under the MIT licence. Each page below covers one topic.

items.title: Privacy
items.body: What we collect, consent-based analytics, what the games keep on your device, and who hosts the site.

items.title: Cookies and storage
items.body: No cookies until you accept analytics. Every cookie and setting, and how to clear them.

items.title: Terms of use
items.body: The rules for using the site and playing the games, written simply.

items.title: Open-source licences
items.body: Every repository's licence, plus the third-party notices that ship with the games.

items.title: Accessibility
items.body: What works today, where the games still fall short, and how to report a barrier.

items.title: Contact
items.body: Bugs, ideas, press and security reports each have their own channel.
